method unique_digits(x: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
    requires forall i :: 0 <= i < x.Length ==> x[i] >= 0
    ensures forall y :: y in result ==> y in x && !has_even_digit(y)
    ensures result == SeqSort(result) 
    ensures result.Length == (if |x| == 0 then 0 else |{ y | y in x && !has_even_digit(y) }|)

method has_even_digit(n: int) returns (result: bool)
    requires n >= 0
    ensures result ==> exists d :: d in digits(n) && d % 2 == 0
    ensures !result ==> forall d :: d in digits(n) ==> d % 2 != 0

method digits(n: int) returns (d: seq<int>)
    requires n >= 0
    ensures |d| > 0 ==> forall i :: 0 <= i < |d| ==> d[i] >= 0 && d[i] < 10
    ensures |d| == 0 ==> n == 0
```
